build_clvp_conditional_generation: build a CLVP model for conditional speech generation with text conditioning and contrastive loss
generate_speech_from_text: generate speech tokens from text input using CLVP conditional generation model with conditioning encoder
extract_text_speech_embeddings: extract text and speech embeddings for contrastive similarity scoring between modalities
compute_speech_text_contrastive_loss: compute speech-text contrastive loss for training multimodal embedding alignment
fix_speech_decoder_output: fix and post-process generated speech decoder output tokens by replacing eos and adjusting trailing tokens
